content.content: 1. Necessity: re-application needs the restoration promise for the boundary it re-applies — without it, restoring is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Re-application is where the redo leg meets the restoration; the gate keeps the use sound without testing redo itself.
